# Company
Bassir System is a Moroccan point-of-sale (POS) software company.
Founded in Morocco, built by Moroccans, for Moroccan merchants.
Website: https://bassir-system.ma
Contact: +212 661 41 55 78 / +212 615 08 72 13
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/212661415578

# What we do
Bassir System provides a complete commerce digitalization solution for Moroccan businesses.
Our software has a 100% Arabic interface with PIN login.
We offer a perpetual licence — one payment, lifetime use, no monthly subscription.
We install, configure, and support businesses across all of Morocco.

# Products
- Bassir System POS Software: Arabic-language point-of-sale software, perpetual licence, PIN login, inventory management, sales reports
- Dual-screen POS terminal: operator touchscreen + customer-facing display
- Thermal receipt printer: silent, fast, integrated with Bassir software
- Rongta RLS1000 barcode scale: directly connected to Bassir software, automatic price calculation
- Cash drawer: lockable, integrated under the terminal
- RFID wristbands: NFC silicone bracelets for hammam, pool, and gym access control and cashless payment
- RFID USB reader: reads cards and key fobs
- Barcode scanner: handheld scanner compatible with Bassir System

# Target customers
- Épiceries (grocery stores)
- Supérettes and supermarkets
- Boucheries (butcher shops)
- Hammams (Moroccan baths)
- Piscines (swimming pools)
- Salles de sport (gyms and fitness centers)
- Pharmacies
- Any retail commerce in Morocco

# Key differentiators
1. Only Moroccan POS software with 100% Arabic interface (not a translation)
2. Perpetual licence — no subscription, no monthly fees
3. Full hardware + software + installation + support package
4. RFID access control and cashless payment for wellness centers
5. Human support team that responds in Arabic, French, and Darija
6. Installation anywhere in Morocco within 24-48 hours

# Service areas
Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Fès, Tanger, Agadir, Meknès, Oujda, Tétouan, and all cities in Morocco.

# Frequently asked questions
Q: Is there a monthly subscription?
A: No. Bassir System uses a perpetual licence. Pay once, use forever.

Q: Is the interface in Arabic?
A: Yes, 100% Arabic interface with PIN login. Designed for Moroccan commerce, not translated.

Q: Do you serve hammams and swimming pools?
A: Yes. Complete RFID solution: wristbands, access control, cashless payment — all integrated.

Q: Where do you install?
A: Everywhere in Morocco. Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Fès, Tanger, Agadir and beyond.

Q: What hardware do you provide?
A: Dual-screen terminal, thermal printer, cash drawer, barcode scale, RFID wristbands, scanner. Full installation included.
